rules.statement: Declare every NuGet package version once, as a `<PackageVersion>` in `Directory.Packages.props` (Central Package Management); a project's `<PackageReference>` must not carry a `Version` attribute or use a shared `$(SomeVersion)` property instead.
rules.why: Inline or per-project versions drift across projects and turn a dependency bump into an easy-to-miss N-file edit. Central Package Management is NuGet's built-in way to do this and also supports transitive pinning.
rules.check: Look for `Version=` or `VersionOverride` on `<PackageReference>` in .csproj/.props files, or new `*Version` MSBuild properties used to set package versions, instead of a `<PackageVersion>` entry in Directory.Packages.props.

rules.statement: Do not hard-code `Version`, `AssemblyVersion`, `FileVersion` or `PackageVersion` in project files; the whole package family gets one version from Nerdbank.GitVersioning's root `version.json`, with `AssemblyVersion` pinned to major precision.
rules.why: Lockstep versioning that comes from git height makes every release reproducible from a commit. Keeping one binding identity per major version makes minor and patch upgrades drop-in.
rules.check: Look for `<Version>`, `<AssemblyVersion>`, `<FileVersion>`, `<VersionPrefix>` or `<PackageVersion>` properties in .csproj/.props files, nested per-project `version.json` files, or changes to `assemblyVersion.precision` away from `major`.

rules.statement: Keep `cloudBuild.setVersionVariables` set to `false` in `version.json`; a CI workflow that needs the version must ask for it explicitly with `nbgv get-version` instead of turning the environment-variable export back on.
rules.why: Nerdbank.GitVersioning writes to GITHUB_ENV from parallel MSBuild nodes without a lock. This tears lines in that file and fails jobs whose work succeeded, and nothing reads the exported variables.
rules.check: Look for changes setting `setVersionVariables` to true (or removing it) in version.json, or workflow steps that read `GitBuildVersion` or similar NBGV environment variables without calling `nbgv get-version`.
